text: Minimum €1 bill based on our own measures. If usage doesn't meet our metered amount, it's not billed for that month.

context: The object-storage transfer contract Paul settled: only transfer AWS charges Team Tito for.

label: Section heading

label: Paragraph
text: Use the code HALF at checkout for 50% off the subscription, forever. No form, no proof. The inclusions are not halved.
context: The code word HALF is a placeholder until the promotion code is created in Stripe. Edit it here and the same word will be created.

label: Section heading
context: One line in the plan card's list of what the plan includes.

label: Paragraph
text: Your price is fixed for the year you bought. Rates and country bands are reviewed once a year, in public. Any tightening applies to new subscriptions only. Existing accounts keep the deal they signed up for until they choose to change it.
context: The review promise from the pricing design.

label: Section heading
context: One line in the plan card's list of what the plan includes.

label: Tax
text: Prices exclude value-added tax (VAT). VAT is added at checkout according to your billing country and shown before you pay. The merchant is Team Tito Limited, Dublin, Ireland.
context: One line in the plan card's list of what the plan includes.

label: Paying and cancelling
text: You pay by card through Stripe. From your account's Billing page you can change your card, download invoices and cancel. Cancelling keeps the plan running until the end of the year you paid for.
context: One line in the plan card's list of what the plan includes.

label: Team changes
text: Adding a member to Community or Business charges the rest of the current year for that member straight away, prorated to the day. A member who leaves comes off the bill at renewal.
context: This states the proration decision. 'Straight away' (charged when added) is the recommendation; the alternative is 'on your next invoice'. Whatever you approve here is what the billing worker will do.

label: Privacy
text: We keep no card details, billing name or billing address on our side.
context: One line in the plan card's list of what the plan includes.

label: Closing heading
context: Heading of the closing call to action.

label: Closing text
text: Create an account at console.carloku.com. You sign in with a passkey through Keymail, so there is no password. Every new account starts on Free, and no card is needed. When you want more, open your account's Billing page, choose a plan and pay.
context: One line in the plan card's list of what the plan includes.
